title: Father's cornet and the French Opera
summary: His father played cornet in the French Opera orchestra; his mother took the children to the opera's top tier.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh yeah. Did any of your family play music, your father or mother?

My father played music, played the French Opera. Oh, he did. And then he played out that. What instrument? He played cornet. In those days it was cornet, you know. But then they got the big trumpets, you know. Yeah. And so, well, I don't know. I just naturally took to the cornet.

Did your father play much around home? He played regularly then in the French Opera Orchestra. Yeah. Of course, did you hear much music around home or did you go to the French Opera when you were young?
Well, my mother used to grab us and take us way up on the Trois Cent, they used to call it, way up on the third tier, you know.
And the old French Opera was down on Bourbon and Toulouse or somewhere around there. I understand it all burned down.
It burned down 1919, many years ago.
